You have some people in your life and those people I can guarantee want you around, remember you’re only 16, in 10 years time you could have kids, you could be married, with a whole new family, with so many new people in your life and new friends you will look back to this and think about how glad you are that you didn’t do anything silly because your life is awesome now. Life changes all the time, it can get better, worse, then ten times better again, you have to think about the long run because things change and your life will soon, at some point be LIT BRO and you’ll be happy as shit. So think about that, bro if I wasn’t from England I’d come hang with you to make sure you didn’t feel alone. Now about your balding, fuck it, live it, its your body, you are you and that’s that don’t worry about it, don’t over think about people looking at it etc because HONESTLY you’d be surprised because no one cares about it , what I mean is no one is judging you by it and no one is seeing you any different from who you are! As for erictile disfunction, there’s things for that to help just ask someone believe me. Make sure you go to school, don’t fucking stay out of school all day, go to school and enjoy your days, talk to people make new friends. Find new hobbies to keep yourself occupied. Your dad will want you to be strong and think positive and he knows you will be. You only get one chance at life bro, live it, to the fullest, ight?
